# Project Context (LLM-optimized)

## Directives
- GRAPH-FIRST: explore code via `specd graph`; grep/glob only non-code or last resort. Stale/missing graph → `specd graph index`.
- `specs/` = requirements SoT; never edit directly. Workflow: draft → implement → review → approve → merge → archive. No code without spec; read/update existing specs; avoid duplicates.
- Artifacts, code, comments, docs English. Full spec: `specd specs context <id>`; include globals with `default:*`.
- TypeScript pnpm ESM monorepo. Hexagonal+DDD: domain no I/O; application ports; infrastructure adapters; rich entities enforce invariants; pure stateless services; manual DI.

## Global Specs — load full via `specd specs context <id>`

### default:_global/architecture
- Business packages: domain → application → infrastructure; inner layers never import outer. Domain no I/O; application uses ports; infrastructure excludes composition.
- Entities own invariants/typed transition errors; value objects expose behavior; stateless domain services are exported functions.
- Ports abstract classes with explicit methods. Constructor DI; no IoC/singletons. Validate external YAML at infrastructure boundary; typed `SpecdError`.
- Composition alone imports infrastructure. `createKernel`, `createKernelBuilder`, capability factories share resolver; canonical `createX(deps)`. Public barrels exclude concrete adapters.
- Adapter packages contain no business logic. Dependencies: plugin-* → skills → core; cli/mcp → sdk; sdk → core|code-graph; schema-* standalone; no cycles. Cross core/graph hosts use `@specd/sdk`.

### default:_global/conventions
- Strict TypeScript; `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, ESM NodeNext. Named exports; kebab-case; explicit public returns; no `any`; expected errors use `SpecdError`; immutable domain.

### default:_global/testing
- Vitest; test tree mirrors src; `.spec.ts`; Given/When/Then; no snapshots. Domain/application unit tests mock I/O. Integration uses unique `os.tmpdir()` dirs and cleanup. Ensure cross-platform paths, fixtures, line endings.

### default:_global/docs
- Docs only under `docs/{adr,cli,code-graph,core,guide,mcp,schemas,sdk,skills}`; exceptions: root README, AGENTS, CLAUDE.
- `docs/guide`: title/description/sidebar_position frontmatter; user usage only; configuration/workflows match core; begin with What is SpecD; cover skills, project update, plugins, graph. Keep SDK/package internals outside guide.
- ADR: sequential `NNNN-kebab-case`, MADR, Decision Outcome Confirmation + More Information/Spec; link source specs only.
- Every CLI command needs docs/cli page, index, sidebar; MCP schemas/examples in docs/mcp. Public symbols need full JSDoc.
- Hosts document/import `@specd/sdk` only. SDK collections under `docs/sdk/{core,code-graph,skills,schemas}` require frontmatter. Update affected docs for public composition, template/config cascades, list-contract changes.

### default:_global/eslint
- Type-aware TypeScript: forbid any/default exports; require explicit returns, kebab-case, JSDoc, layer boundaries. Lint before commit.

### default:_global/continuous-integration
- CI on macOS/Ubuntu/Windows for PR+main; pnpm 10.6.5, Node 22, frozen install; build → typecheck → test.

### default:_global/error-handling-conventions
- Expected user failures: `SpecdError`, `specd=true`, UPPER_SNAKE code, actionable message, JSON/TOON metadata.

### default:_global/logging
- Console-compatible `log/info/debug/warn/error`; info for normal events; fatal/trace through error/debug prefixes; abstraction over raw console.

findings.title: Corpus test depends on sibling ../core repo
findings.reason: typescript-language-adapter.spec.ts archive-change corpus test reads files from ../core outside this workspace; ENOENT failure is environmental and unrelated to the facet API renames. 385 other targeted tests pass.

findings.title: Language adapter guide refers the reader to the specification
findings.reason: Scenario requires docs/code-graph/language-adapters.md to state the same core, facets, members, invariants and steps without referring the reader to the spec, and tasks.md requires a self-contained guide with no reference to specs, but checklist step 6 points authors to the facet scenarios in the specification's verification while the page claims to be the complete contract.

evidence.detail: checklist step 6 refers to the facet scenarios in the specification's verification
page claims no other document is needed
task 19.1 requires self-contained guide, no reference to specs

findings.title: No test asserts facet and capability flag independence
findings.reason: Implementation keeps capabilities() separate from facets (registry getCapabilities reads only capabilities(); no code derives hierarchy from reExportLinking), so the scenario holds structurally, but no test asserts that an adapter providing reExportLinking without hierarchy provenance cannot advertise the hierarchy capability; the conformance suite only checks that advertised capabilities have matching output.

evidence.detail: only verifies advertised capabilities against fixtures, never facet-to-capability independence
getCapabilities consults only adapter.capabilities(), never facets

findings.title: Type-level test for former loose methods missing
findings.reason: Scenario requires a type-level test checking that LanguageAdapter declares none of getPackageIdentity, resolvePackageFromSpecifier, resolveRelativeImportPath, buildQualifiedName, resolveQualifiedNameToPath, parseSymbolReference, renderSymbolReference, linkReExports; no such absence test exists (barrel.spec.ts only asserts presence of analyzeFile and resolveImports)

evidence.detail: LanguageAdapter
exports language adapter and model vocabulary types

findings.recommendation: Add expectTypeOf<LanguageAdapter>().not.toHaveProperty(...) assertions for the eight former loose methods

findings.title: No test inspects Go adapter for absent relativeImportResolution
findings.reason: Scenario requires that inspecting the Go adapter shows no relativeImportResolution facet; the implementation omits it (only packageResolution and symbolReferenceSyntax getters exist) but no test asserts the absence (TypeScript's analogous absence is type-tested in package-resolution.spec.ts)

evidence.detail: get packageResolution
facet shape

findings.recommendation: Add a type-level or runtime assertion that GoLanguageAdapter exposes no relativeImportResolution

findings.title: No test inspects Go adapter for absent qualifiedNameResolution
findings.reason: Scenario requires that inspecting the Go adapter shows no qualifiedNameResolution facet; the implementation omits it but no test asserts the absence for Go (only TypeScript is checked in package-resolution.spec.ts)

evidence.detail: get packageResolution
facet shape

findings.recommendation: Add a type-level or runtime assertion that GoLanguageAdapter exposes no qualifiedNameResolution

findings.title: symbolReferenceSyntax.render has no test coverage
findings.reason: Scenario requires a consumer to both parse and render through the symbolReferenceSyntax facet; parse is covered (typescript/php adapter specs, resolve-symbol-reference and provider specs) but no test anywhere calls the facet's render member, which all four adapters implement

evidence.detail: renderSymbolReference
never borrows the syntax of another adapter

findings.recommendation: Add tests exercising symbolReferenceSyntax.render (generic and native spellings) and a consumer that parses then renders through the same facet

findings.title: No test covers the package-identity collision error
findings.reason: The identity collision branch reports an error naming both workspaces but no spec test exercises two workspaces claiming one package identity, so the contract could regress unnoticed.

evidence.detail: collision branch pushes an error naming identity and both workspace names
covers identity throw and first-adapter-wins but no identity collision

findings.title: Identity collision scenario has no test
findings.reason: The added scenario requires an error naming both workspaces when two workspaces claim one package identity; the collision path is implemented but no test in the change's package-import suites exercises two workspaces with the same manifest identity.

evidence.detail: collision branch pushes an error naming the existing workspace and the current workspace
identity and prepare ordering tests exist but no same-identity two-workspace case

findings.recommendation: Add an index test that configures two workspaces returning one package identity and asserts result.errors names both workspaces

findings.title: identity() failure does not disable the packageResolution facet for the run
findings.reason: Facet model requires that a failure inside identity, prepare, or link is recorded as an indexing error and the adapter is treated as if it did not provide the facet for the rest of the run. The indexer disables the adapter (disabledPackageResolution) on prepare and link failures, but the identity catch only records the error and continues to the next adapter for that workspace; the failing adapter still runs prepare and its matchSpecifier/entrySurface remain active in Pass 2, so the facet stays partially enabled contrary to the spec rule.

evidence.detail: facet model: failure inside identity/prepare/link disables the facet for the rest of the run
identity catch records error and continues without adding adapter to disabledPackageResolution
prepare loop disables the adapter only when prepare itself throws
